description: Landing contract (C1) for the synthetic retail source. Authoritative over docs/data_contracts.md.

conventions.format: CSV, comma separated, header row, RFC 4180 quoting, LF line endings
conventions.file_layout: <out>/batch_NNN/<entity>.csv; batch_000 is the initial snapshot, batch_001 onwards are change-feed batches
conventions.sequence: latest version per primary key is the greatest (source_updated_at, event_id)

feed_columns.name: source_updated_at
feed_columns.description: When this version of the record was produced by the source. Sequence column for CDC.

feed_columns.name: change_type
feed_columns.description: snapshot rows describe state at the as-of cut; insert, update and correction rows are change events.

feed_columns.name: batch_id
feed_columns.description: Batch in which the event was first delivered. A replayed row keeps its original batch_id.

feed_columns.name: event_id
feed_columns.description: Stable identifier of the event. Unique per event; a replay repeats it with identical content. Tie-breaker for equal source_updated_at.

customers.description: Customer profiles. Mutable: email and region changes, name corrections.

columns.name: email
columns.description: Synthetic address on a reserved example domain.

columns.name: updated_at
columns.description: Last business change. Equal to source_updated_at in this source.

products.description: Product catalogue. Mutable: price changes, discontinuation, name corrections.

columns.name: status
columns.description: Discontinued products are not sold in new orders.

orders.description: Order headers. Mutable: status progresses pending, paid, shipped, delivered, or ends cancelled.

order_items.description: Order lines. Inserted with the order and never changed.

columns.name: unit_price
columns.description: Product price at order time, MYR. Line total is quantity times unit_price.

payments.description: Payment events. Each record is inserted once with its final status; refunds are separate records.

columns.name: payment_type
columns.description: Direction of money. Amounts are always positive.

business_rules.name: orders.has_items
business_rules.description: Every order has at least one order item.

business_rules.name: orders.paid_amount_matches
business_rules.description: Paid, shipped and delivered orders: succeeded charges equal the order total (sum of quantity times unit_price).

business_rules.name: orders.cancelled_net_zero
business_rules.description: Cancelled orders: succeeded charges minus succeeded refunds is zero.

business_rules.name: orders.pending_not_fully_paid
business_rules.description: Pending orders: succeeded charges are less than the order total (unpaid or partially paid).

business_rules.name: orders.refunds_within_charges
business_rules.description: Succeeded refunds never exceed succeeded charges for an order.

business_rules.name: orders.customer_before_order
business_rules.description: The customer was created before the order was placed.

business_rules.name: payments.after_order
business_rules.description: payment_at is not earlier than the order's order_date.

business_rules.name: customers.updated_after_created
business_rules.description: updated_at is not earlier than created_at.
